GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-12-12T14:27:12Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to get BufferInfo in ExoPlayer 2?
Description: Hi,
**BufferInfo** was available in ExoPlayer 1 in the **processOutputBuffer** method, But in curently veresion bufferInfo not exist in **processOutputBuffer**
In version 1 I had access to **BufferInfo** by extending **MediaCodecAudioRenderer** Class and implementing **processOutputBuffer**
As you can see below

Version 1:
```
@Override
protected boolean processOutputBuffer(long positionUs,
                                      long elapsedRealtimeUs,
                                      MediaCodec codec,
                                      ByteBuffer buffer,
                                      MediaCodec.BufferInfo bufferInfo, //TODO: BufferInfo
                                      int bufferIndex,
                                      boolean shouldSkip)
        throws com.google.android.exoplayer.ExoPlaybackException {

    //using bufferInfo

    return super.processOutputBuffer(positionUs,
            elapsedRealtimeUs,
            codec,
            buffer,
            bufferInfo,
            bufferIndex,
            shouldSkip);
}
```
Last Version:
```
    protected boolean processOutputBuffer(long positionUs,
                                          long elapsedRealtimeUs,
                                          MediaCodec codec,
                                          ByteBuffer buffer,
                                          int bufferIndex,
                                          int bufferFlags,
                                          long bufferPresentationTimeUs,
                                          boolean isDecodeOnlyBuffer,
                                          boolean isLastBuffer,
                                          Format format) throws ExoPlaybackException {

        return super.processOutputBuffer(positionUs,
                elapsedRealtimeUs,
                codec,
                buffer,
                bufferIndex,
                bufferFlags,
                bufferPresentationTimeUs,
                isDecodeOnlyBuffer,
                isLastBuffer,
                format);
    }
```
As you can see there is no **BufferInfo** inside **processOutputBuffer** method in the last version
I need to get BufferInfo for read '**size**' and '**offset**' and '**presentationTimeUs**', How to do this in the latest version?
